meta.source: CelesTrak GP (General Perturbations) element sets, OMM JSON format
meta.credit: Orbital data: US Space Force (18th Space Defense Squadron) via CelesTrak (celestrak.org)
meta.license: The element sets originate as US Government work (public domain). CelesTrak imposes no fee or attribution condition; its binding rule is its usage policy (fetch at most once per update, cache rather than poll).
meta.note: A committed mirror, not a live feed: one machine fetched CelesTrak once and every visitor reads this file, which is what CelesTrak's usage policy asks for. Element sets go stale (SGP4 error grows roughly 1-3 km/day), so the UI shows each set's epoch age. Starlink is evenly sampled for rendering performance; the true tracked count is recorded per group and shown alongside.
